evidence_source: Latest planning estimate and prior task value
computation: min(previous task, min(1, planning + 0.1)) after each model query
missing_value_handling: Initialized to 0.5; no nullable trajectory value
origin: Deterministic transform of model-text confidence/submission intent

semantic_interpretation: Uncertainty assigned to the current plan
evidence_source: Machine-readable confidence in model response; submission command
computation: 1-confidence when parsed; otherwise 0.1 for proposed submission and 0.5 otherwise
normalization: Confidence regex accepts [0,1]; complement lies in [0,1]
missing_value_handling: Missing confidence maps deterministically to 0.1 or 0.5
origin: Model-generated confidence followed by deterministic parsing

semantic_interpretation: Whether repository retrieval produced usable context
evidence_source: Retrieval-stage shell return code and nonempty output
computation: 0.15 after successful nonempty retrieval; 0.8 after failed/empty retrieval; otherwise retained
missing_value_handling: Initialized and retained at 0.5 when no retrieval-stage action occurs

semantic_interpretation: Risk indicated by shell execution behavior
evidence_source: Return code, timeout text, repeated failed command, malformed/submission state
computation: Mean of active signals: rc 0->0 else 0.65; timeout 1; repeated failures min(1,n/3); malformed 0.70
missing_value_handling: 0.5 when no signal; submitted actions retain prior value

semantic_interpretation: Uncertainty after visible tests or static checks
computation: 0.1 for return code 0; 0.9 otherwise; retained outside verification
missing_value_handling: Initialized and retained at 0.5 without verification

semantic_interpretation: Whether retrieved context is available to working state
computation: min(previous memory, 0.15) after successful nonempty retrieval; otherwise retained
missing_value_handling: Initialized and retained at 0.5 without successful retrieval

semantic_interpretation: Stagnation or cycling in action history
evidence_source: Repeated command count, no-new-evidence steps, cycle flag
computation: Mean of min(1,repeats/4), 0, 0, 0, min(1,no-evidence/4), and cycle indicator
missing_value_handling: Unpassed estimator arguments use zero; initialized vector value is 0.5
leakage: Only prior agent actions and visible evidence

computation: On proposed submission min(previous, planning); submitted action 0.05; final success 0.05, failure 0.9
missing_value_handling: Initialized at 0.5 and retained until submission/termination evidence
update_frequency: Submission-intent query, submission action, final termination
leakage: No official evaluation; terminal submission state only
